summary: Practise delegation, performance conversations and team accountability with practical leadership frameworks. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Leadership and people management involves clarifying decision ownership and guiding team delivery. For supervisors, functional managers and project leads, the course builds practical routines for mapping responsibilities with RACI, reviewing team capacity and setting measurable performance agreements. You also practise evidence-based SBI feedback, conflict response planning and change-readiness checks, then track actions and report progress.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already coordinate people or work and need repeatable ways to delegate, manage performance and keep teams accountable.
modules: Kotter Change Readiness and Team Adoption
prerequisites: Prior experience coordinating work, supervising colleagues or contributing to team delivery is recommended. No coding is required.
